lines: The tower has more retail than its shoppers fill; add homes, or hold off on new venues, to lift every venue.
Shoppers: too far from a lobby. Traffic is halved. Keep it within 2 floors of the ground, a sky lobby (every 15th floor) or a working Metro platform.
The tower has more retail than its shoppers fill; add homes, or hold off on new venues, to lift every venue.
Main gripe: the rent is above the going rate. Lower it to keep them.
